steps: Severe symptoms (seizures, coma): cautious hypertonic 3% saline boluses to raise Na ~4–6 mmol/L.
Correct slowly: ≤8–10 mmol/L per 24 h (avoid osmotic demyelination); recheck Na frequently.
Hypovolaemic: 0.9% saline. SIADH: fluid restriction ± treat cause. Hypervolaemic: treat HF/cirrhosis, restrict fluid.
Identify and remove the cause (drugs, cortisol/thyroid deficiency, malignancy).
Watch for over-correction — re-lower with dextrose/desmopressin if too fast.

confirm: Symptomatic low sodium; assess volume status and serum/urine osmolality to classify (hypovolaemic / euvolaemic-SIADH / hypervolaemic).
